settings.title: Processing Time?
settings.content: All orders are processed within 1–2 business days after confirmation. Orders placed on weekends or public holidays will be processed on the next working day.

settings.title: Delivery Time?
settings.content: Once your order is shipped, delivery usually takes 3–5 business days depending on your location.

settings.title: Shipping Charges?
settings.content: We offer free shipping on orders of PKR 3,750 and above. Orders below PKR 3,750 may include a standard shipping fee, which will be shown at checkout.

settings.title: Order Tracking?
settings.content: After your order is dispatched, you will receive a tracking number via email or SMS so you can track your shipment.

settings.title: Delivery Areas?
settings.content: We currently deliver across Pakistan to ensure our customers receive their favorite fragrances safely and conveniently.

settings.title: Delivery Delays?
settings.content: Please note that delivery times may vary during sales, holidays, or due to courier delays.
